{{External|rs}} {{HasTask|Bats}} {{otheruses|the common bat|other bats|Bat (disambiguation)}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Bat |image = [[File:Bat.png|250x250px]] |release = [[14 October]] [[2004]] |update = RS2 Launched! |members = Yes |combat = 6 |size = 1 |examine = An annoying flappy thing. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 1 |aggressive = No |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 35 |slayxp = 8 |cat = Bats |assignedby = turael,spria,mazchna |hitpoints = 8 |att = 5 |str = 5 |def = 5 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 2 |dslash = 2 |dcrush = 5 |dmagic = 2 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |elementalweaknesstype = Air |elementalweaknesspercent = 35 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |id = 2827,10888,14042 }} '''Bats''' are small flying monsters that are most commonly found in numerous dark areas throughout [[Morytania]]. They are weak and pose little threat to players. Stronger and larger variants of bats exist that can be used as alternatives for bat [[Slayer task]]s, such as the [[giant bat]] and [[albino bat]]. A bat found near [[Damis]] during [[Desert Treasure I]] can be used to [[safespot]] him by luring Damis and the other aggressive monsters behind it, making the fight considerably easier. ==Locations==
